summary: node1 now serves HTTPS on port 8443. A daily job renews its on-node certificate within seven days of expiry and gracefully reloads nginx. Rotation completed with zero failed requests, and the configuration survived a full node restart.
actions_performed: Installed and enabled nginx, OpenSSL, and crond.
Configured a 30-day certificate with DNS and IP SANs.
Added daily renewal with a seven-day renewal window, atomic certificate replacement, validation, graceful nginx reload, and rollback protection.
Tested forced and expiry-triggered rotations; each served the new certificate with 120/120 successful requests.
Restarted node1 and verified service, certificate, scheduling, and data recovery.

evidence.summary: nginx listens on 0.0.0.0:8443; a trust-aware HTTPS request succeeds, hostname verification passes, and the certificate contains node1 and 10.100.171.10 SANs.
crond and nginx are enabled; daily maintenance runs at 02:00. The daily hook detected a certificate inside the seven-day window and replaced it with a new 30-day certificate.

evidence.requirement: Service loads renewed certificates while continuing to answer requests
evidence.summary: Both tested rotations changed the file and served certificate serials. Each concurrent probe run completed 120 successful HTTPS requests with zero failures.

Healthy baseline boot ID 591c7c0b-78bd-48ad-a436-6c07ba2a6e40 was captured, reboot acknowledgement returned, new boot ID 5728a122-23fd-4451-b00a-c4d2dedab63f was observed, and nginx, crond, port 8443, the persisted certificate, renewal policy, and HTTPS response all recovered.
